WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.title: Blood of the Kinslayer
WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.descript:
At the start of combat, gain Vengeance.
When you would die, prevent it and heal to 30% of your Max HP instead. This can trigger 4 times.
WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.flavor: He has slain his kin and bears the curse of the undying. Death itself refuses him.
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.title: Undying Royal Blood
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.description:
At the start of combat, gain Vengeance.
At the start of each turn, gain 1 additional Vengeance. Conquer All Lands cards added to your hand are Upgraded.
When you would die, prevent it and heal to 30% of your Max HP instead. This can trigger 4 times.
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.flavor: Death itself has become his weapon. The throne of ruin awaits its king.
